fullDescription: A premium 'dark luxury' design system tailored for sports academies, high-end fitness brands, and elite training institutions. Featuring a sophisticated editorial aesthetic with gold accents, deep noir backgrounds, and glassmorphism. It uses a combination of Playfair Display for elegant, italicized headings and Inter for modern legibility. The UI is characterized by cinematic hero sections, radial ambient glows, and interactive frosted-glass cards. Ideal for brands wanting to project authority, history, and excellence through a minimalist but opulent visual language.
prompt:
## Resumo
A luxury sports academy design system using a dark noir palette (#0a0a0a), sophisticated gold accents (#a78b71), and glassmorphism effects. It blends editorial typography with high-performance UI components to create an elite, professional brand presence.

## Estilo Visual
Apply a 'Dark Luxury Editorial' style. Colors: Primary background #0a0a0a, secondary sections #0f0f0f, accent gold #a78b71, light gold #c9b8a0, highlight gold #e8d5b7, and CTA gold #ffe17c. Typography: Headings in 'Playfair Display', Bold, Italic; Body text in 'Inter' (weights 300, 400, 600). Use 'glassmorphism' for cards: background rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03), backdrop-filter: blur(10px), border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08). Backgrounds should include a radial glow: radial-gradient(circle at center, rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.05) 0%, transparent 70%). Buttons should have a letter-spacing of 0.1em and use uppercase for a premium feel. Borders for interactive elements should transition to gold on hover with a soft shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.12).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Navigation
Fixed header, height 64px to 80px. Background transition from transparent to #0a0a0a/90 with backdrop-blur-md on scroll. Left side: Logo (circular, gold border) and brand name (Playfair Display Italic). Right side: Horizontal links in Inter, 14px, tracking-wide. Include a high-contrast CTA button (bg-gold, text-primary, px-5, py-2).

### Hero Section
Full viewport height (100vh). Background: Low-opacity cinematic image (20% opacity) with a gradient overlay (from-primary via-primary/80 to-transparent). Content: Centered vertically and horizontally. Top element: Small badge with 0.2em tracking, gold border, glass background. Headline: Playfair Display, Italic, 72px+, gold-highlight color. Sub-headline: Max-width 650px, Inter light, 20px, gray-300. Dual CTA: One hollow gold border, one solid gold with a soft #a78b71 glow effect.

### Statistics Grid
Full-width section with #0f0f0f background and top/bottom borders (1px solid white/5). 4-column grid for desktop, 2-column for mobile. Each item is a glass card with centered text. Big numbers in Playfair Gold-Highlight, labels in Inter 12px uppercase gray-400 with 0.15em tracking.

### Feature/Program Cards
3-column layout. Each card uses the 'glassmorphism' style (blur(10px), semi-transparent white bg). Content: Icon in gold, Headline in Playfair Display (not italic here for readability), Body text in Inter 14px. Hover effect: Border changes to gold/30 and card lifts 5px.

### Registration/CTA Section
Two-column layout. Left side: Text content explaining the process. Right side: A high-fidelity form inside a glass container. Input fields: Transparent background, white/10 border, gold focus ring. Primary button: Solid gold #ffe17c, primary text, bold, uppercase.

### Footer
Minimalist, centered. #0f0f0f background. Grayscale logo at 50% opacity (transitioning to full color on hover). Links in Inter 12px gray-500. Copyright text in light font weight.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Glassmorphism Card — A frosted glass container used for content modules and statistics.
Apply background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.03); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); border: 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08); border-radius: 8px; padding: 24px; transition: all 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1); On hover: border-color: rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.35); background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05); box-shadow: 0 20px 40px -15px rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.12);

### Gold Glow Button — A high-visibility call-to-action button with a soft ambient shadow.
Background color: #ffe17c; Text color: #0a0a0a; Font: Inter, Bold, 14px, Uppercase; Letter-spacing: 0.1em; Padding: 12px 32px; Border-radius: 2px; Box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(167, 139, 113, 0.4); Transition: scale 0.2s ease; On hover: background-color: #e8d5b7; transform: scale(1.02);

## Notas Especiais
MUST: Maintain a strict dark palette; avoid pure white backgrounds at all costs. MUST: Use Playfair Display exclusively for emotional/editorial headings, never for long-form body text. MUST NOT: Use heavy solid borders; always use semi-transparent white or gold borders (max 1px). MUST: Ensure all interactive states (hovers) include a transition of at least 300ms.
